hypothesis: Iter 111 is the person-model cold run. Iter 110 already made the glucagon stimulus the teacher's 3.5, and that constant stays: there is no log_alpha_gn. The person model cannot warm-start from the iter 110 checkpoint. Four per-person setpoints (Gb, HR0, DBP0, RR0) decode in the lognormal family the teacher draws them from, so an iter-110 head weight would decode to a different setpoint at the same output. Two per-person heads the teacher never varies are deleted (stress.phase_proj, hepatobiliary.cck_baseline_net). The metabolic Ra gain is deleted and its authority moved into the gut kernel's bioavailable fraction, now sigma-bounded so absorbed <= ingested. Hepatic output is release into plasma. A strict load of an iter-110 artifact raises on the deleted keys, and a strict=False load would carry mis-scaled per-person decoders. --init-from is absent.
expectedEffect: BY CONSTRUCTION (tests, no training needed): alpha_gn is 3.5 after any perturbation and Gnb stays 70; absorbed <= ingested on every gut channel at any embedding norm (the old softplus head reached a bioavailable fraction of 4.9 and exceeded 1 for 13-26% of embeddings at ||e|| 3-8); SBP > DBP > 0 and HRV > 0 for every embedding, now as sums of strictly positive log-decoded terms; a zero embedding decodes to exactly NORM_CENTER for all six setpoints; the population mean of every log-decoded setpoint sits strictly above its zero-embedding value by Jensen (E[HR_sp] - HR_sp(0) 0.000 -> +1.656 against the teacher's own +1.757); the embedding table's mean is pinned to ~0, so the calibration prior's centre and the gate's evaluation point are one place. SUPERVISION CHANGES, which is what needs the gate to judge: the two cold sweeps (gut 0.10, insulin 0.30) now score the zero embedding only, which raises the zero row's gradient share from 1/5 to 1 -- the pull at zero is 5x the old one at unchanged weights, and that is the single most likely source of a regression. Cohort statistics score the debiased batch mean over sampled rows only, with --cohort-sample-patients raised 2 -> 4 so the subtracted sampling variance has 3 degrees of freedom instead of 1. WATCH: textbook_mean_pass_rate (the zero embedding is now pulled harder and is the textbook evaluation point); setpoint_supervision per-marker MAE (the centring term must not flatten per-patient structure); the cortisol argmax, which sits at 08:44 against the 09:00 rule edge with the phase head gone and only k_crh/k_acth/k_cort able to move it. BASELINE: an iter-110 artifact does not load on this tree, so the comparison is iter 110's own report plus a frozen-ruler re-score of THIS artifact.
